description.value: Pizza Factory Steveston is a family-owned pizzeria in Steveston Village that has been serving Richmond for over 30 years. The family makes dough fresh daily with homemade tomato sauce and sources cheese and toppings daily, offering a wide range of classic and creative pies including tandoori chicken, seafood, and heart-shaped specialty pizzas. The business is deeply embedded in the local community, sponsoring schools and charities and hosting annual free-slice appreciation days.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack at 49m; rack (6 spaces) at 52m; rack at 80m; stands (5 spaces) at 84m; rack at 87m; rack at 98m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully live and corroborates an active family-owned pizza restaurant at 12020 First Ave #120, Richmond, BC V7E 3L9, phone (604) 233-7777. The site explicitly offers pickup and delivery, and customer reviews plus menu descriptions confirm vegetarian and vegan options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizza Factory' but the business consistently brands itself as 'Pizza Factory Steveston' on its website; OSM branch tag 'Steveston' partially accounts for this.
Phone and address are absent from OSM tags — sourced from website only.
Website page title contains a typo ('Pizza Factory Stevenson') which differs from the correct 'Steveston' used throughout the rest of the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pizza restaurant in Steveston Village with a live website, confirmed address, and operating hours. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and pickup options in Richmond.

Takeout.detail: Website deals page lists 'Pick Up & Delivery' as ordering options; 'Pick Up Only' deals listed separately, confirming in-store pickup is available

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Customer reviews note 'lots of vegetarian options' and specifically call out 'Black bean Taco pizza with vegan cheese' and 'vegetarian Greek' pizza; menu also lists Margherita and vegetable-based options

wow_evidence: family-owned pizzeria in Steveston Village that has been serving Richmond for over 30 years
